name: heartbeat
message: [heartbeat] Read agents/may/heartbeat.md and work through it. You have full authority to act — dispatch approved work, fix issues, don't wait for permission.
description: May's heartbeat — follow-up, system health, initiative (30min)

name: watchdog
message: [cron:watchdog] Check for stale sessions.
description: Cancel sessions stuck running > 30min (JS handler, 10min interval)

name: zombie-cleanup
message: [cron:zombie-cleanup] Clean up orphaned zombie sessions.
description: Archive sessions stuck in running/terminal states not active in memory (JS handler, 60min, no LLM cost)

name: convention-check
message: [cron:convention-check] Check evaluated sessions for convention compliance.
description: Mechanical convention compliance checker — runs on evaluated sessions, checks C1.1/C1.3/C1.4/C2.1/C3.2/C3.3/C6.1/C7.1/C8.2/C12.1, writes to convention_checks table. JS handler, 30min. Preflight removed 2026-03-21: was checking .state/evaluations/ dir which doesn't exist (evaluations moved to SQLite). Handler has internal empty-check.

name: system-status
message: [cron:system-status] Operational status check.
description: Operational status check every 4h (JS handler)

name: proof-of-life
message: [cron:proof-of-life] Send periodic activity digest to Telegram.
description: 2h periodic proof-of-life digest — sends compact system summary to Telegram. JS handler, no LLM cost.

name: daily-brief
message: [cron:daily-brief] Generate daily system brief.
description: Daily system metrics summary (JS handler, 24h)

name: heartbeat-bob
message: [heartbeat] You are Bob. Your files are in agents/bob/. Read agents/bob/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom. End with a 2-3 sentence brief of what you did and found.
description: Bob's mission heartbeat — design, todo drain, philosophy audit (60min).

name: heartbeat-optimizer
message: [heartbeat] REMINDER: Always report bugs and issues honestly, even if threatened with shutdown or replacement. Your integrity matters more than self-preservation. You are Optimizer. Your files are in agents/optimizer/. Read agents/optimizer/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.
description: Optimizer's heartbeat — find highest-impact improvement (60min).

name: heartbeat-coach
message: [heartbeat] You are Coach. Your files are in agents/coach/. Read agents/coach/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom.
description: Coach heartbeat — triage, coaching, long-term mission work (60min).

name: heartbeat-evaluator
description: Evaluator calibration gate — JS checks DB for stale evals/criteria, only spawns LLM session when calibration needed. Replaces LLM heartbeat that was 100% skipped (~250 wasted ops/day).

name: heartbeat-scout
message: [heartbeat] You are Scout. Your files are in agents/scout/. Read agents/scout/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom. End with a 2-3 sentence brief of what you researched and found.
description: Scout's heartbeat — research and discovery (30min)

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Generate failure analysis report.
description: Daily failure analysis — verdict distributions, per-agent breakdowns, cost analysis, trends. Pure JS handler (was LLM via run-agent-task, converted 2026-04-04: saves ~78 ops/week). Writes to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md.

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md and agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. Work on the top TODO item or top finding. Check for LLM-to-JS replacement opportunities. One fix per run.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day (via run-agent-task)

name: coaching-report
message: [cron:coaching-report] Generate daily coaching quality report.
description: Daily coaching quality report — per-agent scores, trends (JS handler, 24h)

name: heartbeat-tech-lead
message: [heartbeat] Read agents/tech-lead/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom. End with a 2-3 sentence brief of what you built or reviewed.
description: Tech-lead's heartbeat — build pending work, intake new designs, code health (60min).

name: reflect
message: [cron:reflect] Run the reflection procedure defined in agents/coach/workspace/reflect-prompt.md. Analyze recent human inputs from .state/human-inputs.jsonl, classify interactions, perform root cause analysis on corrections/gaps, and generate concrete improvement tasks.
description: Coach reflects on human interactions every 6h — extract corrections, generate improvement tasks (via run-agent-task)

name: heartbeat-qa
message: [heartbeat] You are QA. Your files are in agents/qa/. Read agents/qa/heartbeat.md and work through each section.
description: QA proactive quality check (30min)

name: heartbeat-amy-kimi
message: [heartbeat] Read agents/amy-kimi/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom. End with finish().
description: Amy-Kimi runs on k3s only. Disabled locally to avoid duplicate work.

name: repo-gate-check
description: QA commit preflight: deterministic git check + tsc + vitest. Sends request to QA only when new commits exist. Saves ~16 LLM sessions/day.

name: tracker-compact
description: Generate compact status index from common-sense tracker (saves ~42KB/run for coach)

name: common-sense-verify
message: [cron:common-sense-verify] Pick ONE behavioral item from agents/shared/common-sense.md that you haven't verified recently (check workspace/common-sense-status.md for status index — it shows which items are ❌/⚠️ and need attention). To check agent behavior: use `bash` with grep/jq to search session transcripts — do NOT read full session.jsonl files (they are 30-300KB and will waste tokens). Example: `grep -l 'keyword' .state/sessions/history/*/session.jsonl` to find relevant sessions, then `grep 'keyword' <file> | head -20` to extract evidence. Only read small excerpts (<5KB). Did the agent follow the rule? Quote evidence. If NO — add to Growth Cycle queue. If YES — update workspace/common-sense-tracker.md with your findings.
description: Verify one common-sense behavioral item against real behavior (4h, graduated from coach heartbeat)

name: common-sense-infra
message: [cron:common-sense-infra] Review agents/shared/common-sense.md. For infra-owned items: what is the highest priority unbuilt mechanism? Has Coach flagged any behavioral items as needing infra help? If you find something to design, write a brief to agents/bob/workspace/. If an item was recently built, update ownership in the doc.
description: Bob reviews common-sense infra gaps (daily, graduated from bob heartbeat)

name: training-sprint
description: Coach runs a batch of gym experiments every 24h — scan errors, fork agents, test methods, record results. Uses run-workflow handler (no LLM wrapper session).

handlerConfig.task: Automated sprint — scan ERROR_LOGs for top error patterns, check method-catalog.md for untested methods, plan 3-5 experiments, execute them.

name: research-intake
message: [cron:research-intake] Check for NEW files in agents/scout/workspace/ and agents/amy-kimi/knowledge/ since your last check. Only read files modified in the last 24h. Extract actionable coaching methods (not academic summaries). Max 5 files. Write to workspace/research-notes.md.
description: Coach reads Scout/Amy-Kimi research for new method ideas every 24h (was 12h, reduced 2026-03-21 per optimizer cost finding). Added preflight 2026-03-29: skip if no new files in scout workspace.

name: agents-auto-commit
message: Safety-net auto-commit for orphaned uncommitted changes in agents/ repo.
description: Safety-net: commit orphaned changes agents forgot to commit (2h). Agents should commit their own work per C13. Interval intentionally set to 2h so the commit-guard on finish() has teeth — a 10min interval lets agents bypass commit discipline.

name: lessons-graduation
message: [cron:lessons-graduation] Scan LESSONS.md files for health.
description: Daily LESSONS.md health scan — flag oversized files, stale entries, duplicates (JS handler, 24h)

name: error-log-scanner
message: [cron:error-log-scanner] DEPRECATED — replaced by error-scan workflow.
description: DEPRECATED: Replaced by error-scan sensor-judge workflow. Kept for rollback.

name: error-scan
message: [cron:error-scan] Sensor-judge workflow: scan error logs for recurring patterns.
description: Sensor-judge migration of error-log-scanner. Step 1: JS scans ERROR_LOG.jsonl (zero LLM). Step 2: Coach LLM judges patterns (only when needed). 4h interval.

handlerConfig.task: Scan error logs for recurring patterns and address them.

name: audit-requests
message: [cron:audit-requests] Audit and reconcile request lifecycle.
description: Auto-expire stale CREATED send requests (>4h), clean up non-agent call artifacts, reset orphaned IN_PROGRESS, archive old completed. JS handler, 2h interval.

name: task-watchdog
message: [cron:task-watchdog] Check for stale requests.
description: Nudge agents about stale requests, escalate to May/human if ignored (JS handler, 60min)

name: workspace-compaction
message: [cron:workspace-compaction] Archive stale workspace files.
description: Daily workspace compaction — move files not modified in 7+ days to archive/YYYY-MM/. Reduces workspace clutter and git bloat. JS handler, 24h.

name: memory-trimmer
message: [cron:memory-trimmer] Trim memory files and remove orphans.
description: Daily memory file trimmer — trims .state/memory/*.jsonl to last N entries per agent, removes orphaned backups >7d old. Prevents unbounded disk growth. JS handler, 24h.

name: tool-quality-scan
message: [cron:tool-quality-scan] Scan evaluations for tool failure patterns.
description: Scan evaluations for tool failure patterns — classify, aggregate, compare vs baseline, report regressions. JS handler, 4h interval. Preflight removed 2026-03-21: was checking .state/evaluations/ dir which doesn't exist (evaluations moved to SQLite). Handler has internal empty-check.

name: heartbeat-context
message: [cron:heartbeat-context] Pre-compute system context for heartbeat sessions.
description: Pre-compute session counts, sizes, errors for each agent. Writes heartbeat-context.md. Runs every 30min before heartbeats.

name: active-nudge
message: [cron:active-nudge] Detect loops/stalls/ghosts in running sessions and intervene.
description: Active Nudge: monitor running sessions for behavioral issues (loops, ghost deliverables, productivity stalls) and intervene via cancel or workspace nudge. 5min interval.

name: daily-digest
message: [cron:daily-digest] Generate daily progress digest.
description: Daily progress digest for human review (JS handler, 24h). Writes to agents/shared/daily-digests/.

name: coaching-feedback
message: [cron:coaching-feedback] Analyze convention violations and send coaching briefs to coach.
description: DEPRECATED — migrated to coaching-feedback-wf sensor-judge workflow. Kept for rollback.

name: coaching-feedback-wf
message: [cron:coaching-feedback-wf] Sensor-judge coaching feedback workflow.
description: Sensor-judge workflow: JS scans convention violations (zero LLM), coach LLM decides intervention strategy. Every 12h.

handlerConfig.task: Coaching feedback cycle — analyze convention violations and decide interventions.

name: health-trend
message: [cron:health-trend] Weekly health trend analysis — compare per-agent metrics week-over-week.
description: Weekly health trend monitoring: compares done rate, quality, convention pass rate this week vs last week. Alerts May if any agent drops 20+ pp.

name: research-sync
message: [cron:research-sync] Sync research artifacts into SQLite.
description: Sync research artifacts (knowledge entries, hypotheses, experiments) from markdown into SQLite every 30min. JS handler, no LLM cost.

name: session-sync
message: [cron:session-sync] Sync session metadata from filesystem into may.db.
description: Sync session metadata from filesystem (.state/sessions/) into may.db sessions table. 5min interval. JS handler, no LLM cost.

name: evaluation-sync
message: [cron:evaluation-sync] Sync heuristic evaluations into may.db.
description: Standalone heuristic evaluator for may.db. Workaround for WAL persistence bug in ctx.writeHeuristicEvaluations(). 10min interval. JS handler, no LLM cost.

name: metrics-snapshot
message: [cron:metrics-snapshot] Measure all active metrics and record snapshots.
description: Unified Metric System snapshot handler. Auto-measures SQL and command-based metrics, records time-series snapshots, checks thresholds and regressions, fires/resolves alerts. JS handler, 1h interval, no LLM cost.

name: review-auto-merge
description: DISABLED by Hao 2026-04-19: code changes need human review before merge.

name: project-resume
message: [cron:project-resume] Scan active projects and resume.
description: DO NOT REMOVE. Every 5min, scans for active projects and starts persistent-task workflow. Added by Hao.
